institution.name: Los Angeles County College of Nursing and Allied Health

plan.major: Nursing (Advanced Placement for Licensed Vocational Nurses, Option I)
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official Los Angeles County College of Nursing and Allied Health curriculum pages (dhs.lacounty.gov): the 'Advanced Placement for LVN Option I' curriculum plan (Summer Semester + Semesters 3-4 with Theory/Laboratory units; 'Successful completion of N125 is prerequisite to Semester 3 courses' and 'Successful completion of Semester 3 is prerequisite to Semester 4 courses', encoded as per-course prereqs) and the 'Prospective Student Admission Requirements' page (the same 10 general-education prerequisite courses, 31 units, required for LVN-RN applicants). Admission also requires a current California LVN license. Catalog year 2026-2027 per the official CONAH Catalog 2026-2027 linked on the college's 'Who we are' page. GE prerequisites and the 21 units of advanced-standing credit for vocational nursing education are encoded as a single prerequisite block (accelerated LVN-to-RN convention); per-course credits = Theory + Laboratory units. Degree total: 23 nursing units (10 theory + 13 clinical) + 21 VN education credit + 31 GE units = 75. Completers are considered graduates, receive the AS in Nursing, and are eligible for the NCLEX-RN.
